title: SetAsideResponse
description: The branch the work was set aside on, or that there was nothing to set aside.

oneOf.description: The changed and untracked files were committed to a new branch, and the worktree is back at its head with no changes.

folder.description: The worktree's folder, relative to the project.

branch.description: The new branch, forge/wip/<slice>/<n>, with n the next unused number.

commit.description: The commit on the new branch that holds the work, in full. Its parent is the worktree's head.

oneOf.description: The worktree had no changed or untracked files, so nothing was done.

how.description: Nothing was set aside, and no branch was made.

folder.description: The worktree's folder, relative to the project.
